findings.description: Immediate Busy rollback invokes CancelOwner(managedProgressOwner). If that owner is an existing checkpoint context with a different active panel, Busy means the progress request owns no ticket, yet rollback cancels the preexisting unrelated ticket. Hub newly-created scopes do not share this issue.
findings.recommendation: Separate rejected-open rollback from owned-ticket close: hide/reset progress fields without cancelling an existing checkpoint owner ticket that was not acquired. Add same-owner/different-panel Busy regression.

findings.description: After OpenManagedProgressDialog rejects Busy/ParentClosed and CloseProgressAction(false) hides popup/restores source, ShowProgressAction continues and unconditionally selects a now-hidden popup button.
